# The Windows sandbox repair changes the child service callback and its header

The owned Windows MOZ_SANDBOX branch includes TargetGeckoServices.h and supplies SetTargetGeckoServices through childData.setTargetGeckoServices before XRE_InitChildProcess. It replaces the old logging callback member, so the change has an actual service-interface role. The previously documented target-service/XPCOM ordering is reused separately. Fixed comm source retains the new member/header, but the paired Gecko interface and implementation were not inspected; no ABI, sandbox or build result is established.

Scope: Thunderbird Windows sandbox child startup bridge.
